name: Feature request

title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What user problem or workflow gap would this solve?

## Proposed change

Describe the smallest useful behavior. Avoid prescribing implementation before the scope is agreed.

## Scope classification

- [ ] Core — required for the current MVP loop
- [ ] Enhancement — improves the loop but is not required for it
- [ ] Future direction — intentionally deferred until a named validation trigger
- [ ] Idea repository — interesting but not scheduled

If this is not Core, explain why it should be tracked rather than implemented immediately.

## Acceptance evidence

How would we know that the change works, and what existing behavior must remain unchanged?
